title: LCG Random Generator Trace
description: Calculate states for congruential generator R_{i+1} = (a * R_i + c) mod T. Parameters: a=1, c=4, T=5, seed R_0=2. Normalized output U_i = R_i / T.
hint: LCG recurrence calculates remainder of division by T. Target: a=1, c=4, T=5.

title: Monte Carlo Coin Flips
description: Simulate fair coin trials. Random numbers: RN < 0.5 is Head, otherwise Tail.
hint: Check bounds: 0.0 <= RN < 0.5 is Head; 0.5 <= RN < 1.0 is Tail.

title: Traffic Light Observations Mapping
description: Map single-digit random numbers (0-9) to traffic colors. Distribution: Green 40% (digits 0-3), Yellow 10% (digit 4), Red 50% (digits 5-9).
hint: Check which digit subrange the random number falls into: 0-3 Green, 4 Yellow, 5-9 Red.

title: Life Insurance Sales Multi-Stage Decision
description: Trace customer decision trees. Stage 1: RN1 <= 49 -> Interested (50%). Stage 2 (if interested): RN2 <= 59 -> No Sale (60%); 60-79 -> Small Policy (20%); 80-99 -> Large Policy (20%).
hint: If RN1 >= 50, client is Not Interested, and Stage 2 is skipped (fill '-' and 'No Interest').

title: Antithetic Variates Calculation
description: Calculate variance reduction complementary pairs for X = r^2. Compute complement r' = 1 - r, and outcomes X and X'. Find the antithetic average.
hint: Complement r' is 1 - r. X is r squared, X' is r' squared. Average is (X + X') / 2.

title: Queue Transit Time Trace
description: Trace customer transit delays in a FIFO single-server queue. Compute Start Service, Departure Time, and Waiting Time. Formula: Start_i = max(Arrival_i, Departure_{i-1}). Delay = Start - Arrival.
hint: Customer cannot start service until the server is free from the previous customer.

title: Continuous Inverse Transform CDF Mapping
description: Generate continuous observations. 1) Uniform distribution U(5, 15): Y = 5 + 10 * r. 2) Exponential distribution rate lambda=2: X = -0.5 * ln(1 - r). Use four decimals.

title: Inventory Reorder Point (RP, Q) Trace
description: Trace stock updates under RP=5, order quantity Q=10 policy. Order placed when Ending Stock <= RP.
hint: Trigger order if Ending Stock <= 5. Outstanding replenishment arrives after lead time delay.

title: Machine Breakdown & Repair Shop Trace
description: Trace failure repairs under 1 repairman. Repair time is 2 hours. Compute when repair starts, ends, and machine downtime. Repair Start_i = max(FailTime_i, RepairEnd_{i-1}).
hint: Repair shop operates as a FIFO queue. Downtime = Waiting in queue + TTR.

title: Tandem Assembly Line Blocking Trace
description: Trace Bob (Stage 1, takes 3 min/item) and Ray (Stage 2, takes 5 min/item). Buffer capacity is 0. If Bob finishes item i+1 before Ray completes item i, Bob is blocked.
hint: Ray starts item i only when Bob finishes it and Ray is free. Bob finishes item i+1 but is blocked until Ray finishes item i.

title: Clock Scan Event Processing Timeline
description: Trace when arrival/departure events are processed under Periodic Scan (dt = 1.0 min) vs Event Scan clock. Compare event times 1.8 and 3.2.
hint: Periodic scan advances clock by 1.0; events occurring in interval (k-1, k] are processed at end-time k. Event scan processes them immediately.

title: M/M/1 Time Scan Transition Probability
description: Calculate continuous scan transition probability for arrival rate lambda = 20/h and service rate mu = 25/h. P(Arrival in dt) = 1 - e^(-lambda * dt). Find probabilities for dt=1 min and dt=2 min (use four decimals).
hint: dt in hours is minutes / 60. Exponent is lambda * dt. Probability is 1 - exp(-exponent).
